# Preserved pre-correction API examples

The three JSON files in this directory are archived responses from the earlier
independent crop-year engine. They are retained for provenance, **not current
frontend contracts or validated outputs**. Their survival/severe-stress fields,
cover variants, water results and rankings are superseded. Do not use them to
populate the demo or assert corrected scientific results.

Current request/response behavior is described in ../../SCIENTIFIC_VALIDITY.md.
The API tests execute fresh requests against the corrected continuous engine;
synthetic invariant fixtures live in test_scientific_validity.py and are never
presented as NASA observations.
